title: TreeDB: publish recoverable DATA and PRIMARY roots with shared custody
body:
**Draft: M0 stability fails; residual checkpoint costs and final acceptance remain open.**

Ordinary COW publication keeps DATA and PRIMARY roots, both recoverable capsule slots, and their physical resources under the existing transaction authority. Buffered PRIMARY updates reuse the current DATA generation. Readers, recovery, vacuum and teardown retain each actual resource obligation until its original cleanup completes.

Fixes #5111; part of #4871. Native pruning and end-to-end Dgraph qualification remain separate outcomes in #4878/#5047/#4879.

## Scope and invariants

- Complete ordinary producer, snapshot, physical-resource, retained-allocation, recovery, vacuum and caller integration in the [nineteen-group inventory](TreeDB/docs/design/ordinary-primary-allocation-5111.md), using the original allocator, arena, identity registry, transaction and cleanup owners.
- Select PRIMARY for the supported command-WAL COW backend and preserve the composite cache/backend read cut. Foreground publication adds no per-write physical checkpoint.
- Preserve admission before allocation, custody for both eligible slots, last-reader completion, checked physical cleanup and first-error retention. Capture current ValueLogSet and root state under the existing replacement exclusion; carry readers retain the matching Snapshot and pager. The persistent value log remains separate from the redo WAL.
- Keep generic diagnostics valid after physical cleanup through immutable namespace/identity copies and shared atomic counters. Raw logical unions reject selected resources before pointer copying; selected diagnostics retain their admitted ownership path. Actual shared struct sizes remain charged. Generic diagnostic copies add explicit heap storage; selected and absent diagnostic backing remain nil.
- Preserve the unchanged 40% public shrink and 8x output guards, crash-image/root assertions, platform refusal with unchanged pair/custody checks, and all timeout bounds. Private one-shot cleanup skips only permanently unused alternate-reader fields; actual Tree/reader and ownership cleanup remain.

## Candidate and validation

Candidate `2588cd26780fe9ffd8c33797fc6a2bfdf2c00d49`, tree `e4e2e241722d0f7afc9364eb23e729beef7e2165`, based on main `5bca87ffe6e1bfba2d693264d2dc82936adc234f`.

Snapshot cleanup preserves Manager rollback, epoch/inflight ordering and panic-safe unlocking while permitting compiler-generated open-coded cleanup. Ordinary pager verification shares its unchanged body with the separately locked retained path. Singleton resource views avoid generic sort allocation, and PRIMARY iterator storage is allocated only when that root is selected.

Seven focused normal/race/build commands pass with all 10,246 source hashes unchanged. They cover 56 DB and 36 pager top-level tests in each normal/race run; unchanged root-publication source retains its complete 352-test normal/race verification. Independent exact `gpt-6.1-sol` review accepts the four-path delta and final controls. The preceding full ordinary audit inventories all 539 changed paths, directly reviews 123 by risk, and covers all nineteen allocation groups; inventory-only coverage is explicit. This is source review, not final acceptance.

The interrupted-cut fixture requires an exact DB/resource/point match and a successfully captured immutable recovery image before accepting typed recovery-required admission. Normal/race coverage and four expected-failure controls preserve recovery-root, durable-ACK and original-cause assertions. Earlier all-group, lifetime, allocation, shrink and platform evidence remains linked through the [retained predecessor packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/tree/9441f27ecba5ee3ff518497579696db4f7cb46ef/artifacts/4871/20261015-host185-current-costs-get-inquiry).

Current CI is complete: **55 pass, one failure (M0 stability)**. The required TreeDB aggregate passes; the separate M0 acceptance failure still blocks this packet. The one local Get diagnostic refused its original quietness preflight and collected zero timing samples; it was not retried. [Current source, validation, compiler, measurement and failure evidence](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/tree/7a741f8249603fe4d3cc48a1e12d64373f7850f2/artifacts/4871/20261015-host185-2588c-costs-native-decision).

## Current raw and PRIMARY costs

[Run 38816600605](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/actions/runs/38816600605/job/116702731179), actual Go1.26.9. Eight alternating AB/BA pairs per workload; exact committed checkers and all eight executables independently verified. No samples removed. All raw +5% timing, allocation and byte gates pass; enabled PRIMARY activation/reopen and sampled quietness gates pass.

| Workload | Base → candidate ns/op | Base → candidate ops/s | B/op | allocs/op | Paired delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GetVersioned | 424.65 → 411.60 | 2,354,880.49 → 2,429,543.25 | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 | -3.26% |
| Conditional batch write | 36,302.50 → 36,266.50 | 27,546.31 → 27,573.66 | 31945 → 31502 | 127 → 104 | +3.28% |
| Snapshot seek | 223.90 → 226.70 | 4,466,279.59 → 4,411,116.01 | 0 → 0 | 0 → 0 | +1.64% |
| Repeated iterator | 294.60 → 291.30 | 3,394,433.13 → 3,432,887.06 | 112 → 112 | 2 → 2 | +0.14% |
| Durable tiny WriteSync | 225,446.50 → 227,681.00 | 4,435.64 → 4,392.11 | 4578 → 4577.5 | 17 → 17 | +0.79% |
| Enabled PRIMARY operation | 14,989,936.50 → 7,457,169.50 | 66.71 → 134.10 | 280183 → 228297 | 476 → 391 | -50.20% |

PRIMARY DATA-generation advances/op are 2 → 0. Raw timing retains its original process snapshot; PRIMARY has sampled quietness evidence. Different hosted CPUs and earlier candidates are not matched causal evidence. Prior failed Get and M0 runs remain preserved under their own source identities.

## Maintenance, retention and failed stability

The unchanged fourteen-call diagnostic in [run 38817132263](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/actions/runs/38817132263) compares this candidate with main5bca using pinned Go1.26.3 and reviewed harness22e605b. All five source freezes, four executable/compiler bindings, fourteen ordered rows and raw quietness observations are verified. There are only three pairs per maintenance operation.

| Operation | Base → candidate ns/op | Base → candidate ops/s | B/op | allocs/op | Paired delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Public checkpoint | 3,663,559 → 3,868,924 | 272.9586 → 258.4698 | 459330 → 471037 | 858 → 886 | +4.6263% |
| Public vacuum | 2,961,824,831 → 2,934,822,536 | 0.3376 → 0.3407 | 1.861e+08 → 1.79848e+08 | 616118 → 518483 | -0.7996% |

Checkpoint adds **11,707 B/op and 28 allocations/op**; this residual cost remains unaccepted. All pairs remain, including checkpoint +7.67%, +4.63%, −0.52%. Whole-process profiles establish removal of discarded PRIMARY wrappers but include setup and stopped-timer work; they are not per-checkpoint cost attribution. The diagnostic harness is reviewed/frozen, not claimed landed; expensive retained collection still requires landing.

Enabled 8/16-file cohort capture reports 14,721/17,390 ns/op (67,930/57,504 ops/s), 3,722/3,786 B/op and 14/14 allocations/op. Governed retained bytes reach zero at actual Close. Immediate GC still retains 8/16 paths and 6,528/13,056 value-log bytes; no path-deletion claim. Last-reader cleanup takes 66,663/97,564 ns in one off-timer event per cohort, not a latency distribution.

**Current M0 fails** in [run 38816601067](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/actions/runs/38816601067/job/116702733644): legacy vacuum/writer-pause/foreground-p99 CVs are 13.15%/55.30%/23.02%, exceeding the unchanged 10% limit. All 20 rows and the exact summarizer are independently reproduced. Legacy completion, public availability, zero unexpected errors/exposure misses and original digest/index fixture pass; these do not waive failed stability. The current CPU is EPYC9V74 versus predecessor EPYC7763, with no sampled interference telemetry in M0. Cause remains unestablished; neither runner noise nor a product regression is inferred.

M0 stability, final-base compatibility, residual-cost disposition and final independent acceptance remain required. Native producer/Finish/Q32/once-ACK and Dgraph qualification remain separately open.


M0 observation run 38824531924 completed once through the reviewed, landed harness PR #5136 (`eae3435`), on this unchanged product head. All ten interleaved legacy/public pairs and 40,960 ordered legacy operations are retained. Diagnostic vacuum/writer-pause/foreground-p99 CVs were 0.5854%/2.2187%/2.4988%, below 10%; public availability passed. This instrumented run used EPYC7763, whereas the failed original gate used EPYC9V74. Recorded GC pauses alone do not explain operation tails; substantial I/O pressure is unattributed, and the benchmark itself generated substantial writes. **This is diagnostic nonreproduction, not repair or replacement of the original failed M0 gate.** No unchanged-candidate rerun is authorized. [Complete raw observations, exact source/SDK/executed-ELF verification, independent analysis and limitations](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/tree/0e00b207e2d628f2b66b0a58b4ad27c62b3038da/artifacts/4871/20261015-host185-m0-observation-result).

A separately reviewed diagnostic-storage packing successor is available on `codex/5111-diagnostic-packing-185-20261015`; this PR has not advanced to it. Its fixed fourteen-call maintenance harness is PR #5137, independently reviewed with 78 pure tests passing and current-head CI pending. No successor measurement or residual-cost acceptance is claimed.
